keywords: EIP-8250 frame 交易的 keyed nonce 发布
Vitalik 称 keyed nonce 是新状态扩容策略的首次尝试
执行层重组状态保留窗口 EIP
summary: soispoke 宣布 EIP-8250（frame 交易的 keyed nonce），作者为 soispoke、nero_eth、lightclient 与 Vitalik。Vitalik 表示 keyed nonce 不只是为隐私方案提供协议支持，也可能是以太坊新状态扩容策略的首次尝试。donnoh 提出原生证明验证，把共识层证明验证设施开放给所有 rollup 与 ZK 应用。nerolation 提交执行层重组状态保留窗口 EIP。

items.title: soispoke：发布 EIP-8250 frame 交易的 keyed nonce，用 (nonce_key, nonce_seq) 替代单一发送者 nonce，为 frame 交易提供独立的重放域
items.note: 18:59；Magicians 讨论 15:38：nonce_key 为 0 时等同旧账户 nonce，非零 key 对应存放在 NONCE_MANAGER 系统合约中的独立序列。
items.title_en: soispoke: new EIP-8250, Keyed Nonces for Frame Transactions, replacing the single sender nonce with (nonce_key, nonce_seq) to give frame transactions independent replay domains
items.note_en: 18:59; Magicians discussion, 15:38: nonce_key 0 aliases the legacy account nonce, and each non zero key selects an independent sequence stored in a NONCE_MANAGER system contract.

items.topic: 原生证明验证与重组窗口
items.title: ethresear.ch：原生证明验证
items.note: 21:27：泛化 EIP-8025，使共识层的证明验证设施与具体程序无关，并通过携带证明的交易类型与 PROGRAMHASH、PUBVALUESHASH、PROOFCOUNT 三个操作码开放给合约，zkVM 修复随客户端发布而非各项目治理升级；donnoh_eth 的介绍 21:35。
items.note_en: 21:27: generalizes EIP-8025 so CL proof verification is program agnostic, and exposes it to contracts through a proof carrying transaction type and three opcodes (PROGRAMHASH, PUBVALUESHASH, PROOFCOUNT), so zkVM fixes ship with client releases instead of per project governance upgrades; donnoh_eth's intro, 21:35.

items.title: 新增 EIP：执行层重组状态保留窗口
items.note: （nerolation）提交：执行层客户端至少保留 262,144 个区块（约 36.4 天）的状态，可在本地处理任意重组而无需重新同步，覆盖最多约 79% 质押离线的泄漏场景。
items.title_en: Add EIP: Execution-Layer Reorg State Retention Window
items.note_en: (nerolation), submitted: EL clients keep state for at least 262,144 blocks (about 36.4 days) so they can process any reorg locally without resyncing, covering leak scenarios with up to about 79% of stake offline.
items.topic_en: Native proof verification and the reorg window

keywords_en: EIP-8250 Keyed Nonces for Frame Transactions announced
Vitalik calls keyed nonces a first foray into a new state scaling strategy
EL reorg state retention window EIP
summary_en: soispoke announced EIP-8250 (Keyed Nonces for Frame Transactions), authored by soispoke, nero_eth, lightclient and Vitalik. Vitalik said keyed nonces are not only in protocol support for privacy solutions but possibly a first step toward a new state scaling strategy. donnoh proposed native proof verification, opening the CL proof verification stack to all rollups and ZK apps. nerolation submitted an EL reorg state retention window EIP.
